test_plot_components: test the plot_components module by running parameterized tests for track, contact map, and seq logo visualization components
create_plot_figure: create a matplotlib figure from a list of plot components like Tracks, ContactMaps, and SeqLogo over a genomic interval
build_transcript_annotation: build a TranscriptAnnotation component to visualize gene transcripts with exons on a genomic plot
create_tracks_component: create a Tracks component to visualize 1D genomic track data such as ATAC-seq or RNA-seq signals
create_contact_maps_component: create a ContactMaps or ContactMapsDiff component to visualize 2D chromatin contact maps and their differences
